text:
maya (marketing): Hey team — planning to launch the new Labsnap Quickstart (OSS mini-refapp + 20m tutorial). Target: email + blog + short webinar next Tue. need quick thoughts on benchmark narrative, webinar hook, and inbound routing.

 tom (devrel): love it. for the benchmark angle: focus on latency/cost at 1k qps for a common chat flow. simple graph + 2 callouts: median latency, cost per 1k tokens. keeps it digestible.

 sara (growth): inbound — we should gate the webinar RSVP with a short survey (one question: primary use-case). map answers to our nurture flows: dev, pm, infra. drop a UTM per channel.

 liam (engineer): repo is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/labsnap-quickstart. quickstart includes Docker + k8s manifest and a small benchmark script: `scripts/run_bench.sh --concurrency 16 --seq 256`.

 ashley (events): schedule note — Tue 10am PT works for APAC followup later. speakers: maya + tom for demo, liam on infra 5m. we'll do 25m demo + 20m live Q&A.

 deploy-bot: Preview site deployed: https://labsnap-preview.redwood.ai (staging) — build #242 succeeded :rocket:

 tom (devrel): Draft social + blog microcopy below, feel free to edit: 

Blog (short): "Labsnap Quickstart: Get a reference app running with Redwood inference in 15 minutes. Includes a hands-on tutorial, a reproducible benchmark, and suggestions for production-tuning."

 Tweet: "New: Labsnap Quickstart — a 15m OSS refapp for building fast & cost-efficient LLM features with Redwood. Join our free live demo Tue 10am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/labsnap (UTM=tw)"

 maya (marketing): love the copy. one change: call out "benchmark reproducibility" in the tweet? short.

 sara (growth): For routing: funnel signups into /workflows/labsnap-webinar. Tag contacts with `labsnap_webinar_rsvp`. we'll send follow-up: 'get the quickstart + benchmark results' email 1hr after webinar. can we add a short follow-up CTA in the demo?

 liam (engineer): yep — demo will hit `scripts/run_bench.sh` live and push a short JSON report to S3. sample output: `{"median_latency_ms": 38, "cost_per_1k_tokens": "~$0.12"}`. we can attach that to the follow-up email.

 ashley (events): ops checklist: 1) webinar page + RSVP form 2) slides + demo rehearsed 3) CTA docs for post-email 4) tracking UTMs 5) on-call for infra. who owns slides?

 maya (marketing): i'll own slides and main blog. tom you own demo script + benchmark narrative. sara you own registration funnel + nurture tags. liam you'll be on-call for infra + ensure sample report format. ashley you'll run the event logistics.

 tom (devrel): assigning a small checklist in GH issues + PR for demo script. will add 3 short prompts to the tutorial so we can showcase caching/batching wins.

 sara (growth): i'll draft the two-email sequence (reminder + post-webinar with report link). will share copy by EOD Fri.

 deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: calendar invite created and emailed to speakers. Event ID: 2026-04-LABSNAP-01

 maya (marketing): perfect. quick ask for messaging iteration: let's A/B test two subject lines for the follow-up: 1) "Your Labsnap benchmark & quickstart" 2) "How we got 38ms median latency — Labsnap results" — which do people prefer?

 sara (growth): i'll run the A/B test 50/50. leaning towards #2 for opens.

 liam (engineer): small note — benchmark numbers will vary by instance type, we'll include a short table: dev (g5) vs prod (a100) typicals.

 tom (devrel): final: can we get a short 2-min clip recorded of the demo for social snippets? i'll record during rehearsal.

 maya (marketing): thanks all — next sync Monday 10am PT to finalize assets. dropping PR links here once created. :thumbsup:
